DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記帳のご用件とは別に、商品のご案内をお渡ししてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Apart from updating your passbook, may I give you some information about a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 記帳に来ました。新しい商品の説明も今日聞いて、何か申し込む必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記帳とは別の商品説明が当日の必須手続きか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to update my passbook. Do I also need to hear about a new product and apply for something today?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the separate product explanation is a required procedure today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このご案内は、お申込みが必須ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are not required to apply for the product in this information.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、今日は申し込みません。案内を読むために、資料だけ受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新規申込みをせず読む資料だけを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I won't apply today. I'd just like the materials so I can read the information.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you only want materials to read and will not make a new application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料のお渡しとして承ります。後で確かめたい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly, I'll just provide the materials. Is there anything you would like to check later?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 利用に費用がかかるかと、途中でやめる場合の条件を、読んでから質問したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 費用と途中終了の条件を後で質問したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: After reading them, I'd like to ask whether there are fees for using it and what the conditions are if I stop partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to ask about fees and the conditions for stopping partway through later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない点は、資料に書かれた相談先へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please direct any questions to the contact listed in the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今分かったつもりで署名せず、質問をメモしておきます。必要になったら自分で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 理解前の署名をせず質問をメモして自主的に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't sign now as though I understand everything. I'll make a note of my questions and contact them myself if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not sign before understanding, will note your questions, and will seek advice yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料を受け取ることと、申込書を提出することは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Receiving the materials and submitting an application form are separate things.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料は持ち帰るだけにします。今日の記帳を先に進め、新しい商品の手続きはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料持帰りと現在の記帳を新商品の申込から分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll just take the materials home. Please proceed with updating my passbook first; I won't do any procedures for the new product.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish taking the materials home and updating your passbook from applying for a new product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記帳の用件と資料のお渡しのみで承りました。それでは、取引担当へおつなぎします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood: just the passbook update and the materials. I'll connect you with the staff member handling transactions. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通路で立ち止まっておられますが、ご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've stopped in the passageway. May I help you find your way?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真を撮る場所を探していました。同行者は座って観たいので、同じ所にいるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撮影と座って観る同行者で場所の希望が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was looking for somewhere to take photos. My companion wants to watch while seated, so we won't necessarily stay in the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you and your companion want different places for photography and watching while seated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは通行のための場所です。撮影のために待つのは避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This area is for people passing through. Please avoid waiting here to take photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 立ち止まらず移ります。同行者にも、私の撮影について来る必要はないと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路から移り同行者に撮影への同行を求めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll move on without stopping here. I'd also like to tell my companion that they don't need to come along while I take photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the passageway and will not ask your companion to accompany you for photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別行動にするなら、合流の予定を先に相談されてはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you will be going separately, why not discuss your plans for meeting up first?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡して、終了後に合流すると決めます。花火の途中に人の流れを逆向きに歩くのは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 終了後の合流を相談し途中の逆行を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll contact them and arrange to meet after it ends. I'll avoid walking against the flow of people during the fireworks.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss meeting after the event and avoiding walking against the crowd during it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 合流場所は、お二人が分かる場所を選び、会場の案内もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Choose a meeting place you both recognize, and also check the venue information.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地図を二人で見て決めます。写真のために、入れない区画へ移るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図で共通の合流先を決め立入区域も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll look at the map together and decide. I don't intend to enter a restricted section to take photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a shared meeting place using the map and check which areas you may enter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内が分からない場所へ行く前に、係へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before going somewhere whose directions you don't understand, please ask a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮影場所は案内を確認してから選びます。同行者の観覧を優先して、別行動の連絡を済ませます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影場所の案内確認と同行者への連絡を先に行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose a photography spot after checking the information. I'll put my companion's viewing plans first and finish arranging our separate plans with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the photography location information and contact your companion first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お二人の予定を相談してからお楽しみください。通路のご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss your plans together before enjoying the event. Thank you for keeping the passageway clear. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 上映後の感想会について、ご案内をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you seen the information about the discussion after the screening?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見ましたが、映画が終わっても全員残るのか分かりません。帰りの予定があるんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上映後の会への全員参加が必要か帰宅予定と合わせて聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have, but I'm not sure whether everyone has to stay after the film. I have plans for getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether everyone must attend the post-screening event, mentioning your plans for going home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの感想会は希望する方の参加です。映画の終了とは分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This discussion is for people who wish to participate. It is separate from the end of the film.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 参加しなくても、本編は最後まで観られるということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 任意参加でも映画本編を最後まで観られると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I can watch the main film right to the end even if I don't participate, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you can watch the entire main film even though participation is optional. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。本編をご覧になった後、そのままお帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. After watching the main film, you may leave directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、今日は感想会には出ません。同行者は参加したいと言っているので、別に帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分は不参加で同行者と別に帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't attend the discussion today. My companion says they want to participate, so we'll go home separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to participate and to go home separately from your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お連れ様との連絡はお済みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already contacted your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今伝えました。感想会が終わるまでロビーで待つ約束はせず、私は先に帰ると確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ロビーで待たず先に帰る意思を同行者へ確認済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I just told them. I haven't promised to wait in the lobby until the discussion ends; we confirmed that I'll go home first.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have confirmed with your companion that you will leave first without waiting in the lobby. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お荷物はそれぞれお持ちください。上映時間の案内もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please each take your own belongings. Also check the screening schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の荷物は自分で持ちます。本編の終了予定を確認して、帰りの連絡をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の荷物と本編終了予定を確認して帰りを連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll carry my own belongings. I'll check the scheduled end of the main film and let them know about my trip home.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your belongings and the scheduled end of the main film, then communicate your plans for going home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 上映と感想会の予定を分けられましたね。それでは、映画をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've separated your plans for the screening and the discussion. Please enjoy the film.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お声が聞こえにくかったので、ご希望をもう一度確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I couldn't hear your voice clearly. May I confirm what you would like once more?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 声を張るのが難しいので、短いメモを見ていただけますか。大きな声で繰り返すのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 声を張れないため短いメモで希望を伝えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's difficult for me to speak loudly, so could you look at a short note? I'd like to avoid repeating myself in a loud voice.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to communicate your wishes with a short note because you cannot raise your voice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモで結構です。種類と色を分けて書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: A note is fine. Could you write the type and color separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらへ二行に分けました。色だけでは同じ物を選べないと思い、種類も書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 種類と色を別行に書いて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've written them here on two separate lines. I thought the color alone wouldn't identify the same item, so I included the type too.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the type and color written on separate lines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 種類はこちらで、色は白とのご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You would like this type, and the color white, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、その二つです。書いた字が読みにくければ、指で示して確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 復唱された種類と色を確認して必要なら指示し直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, those are the two things. If my handwriting is difficult to read, I'll point to confirm them.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the repeated type and color and point them out again if necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 数量の記載がありませんが、一つでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You haven't written a quantity. Would one be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つお願いします。声だけで答えるより、メモへ数字も足しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足した数量を一つと伝えメモにも加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One, please. Rather than just saying it aloud, I'll add the number to the note too.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that the missing quantity is one and add it to the note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一つをお渡しする前に、メモと見比べてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before I hand you one, please compare it with your note and check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 種類と白色が合っています。これを一つお願いします。メモは自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 渡される物とメモを照合し自分でメモを回収する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The type and the white color match. I'd like one of these, please. I'll take my note home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the item with your note and collect the note yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 種類、色、数量を確認できました。それでは、穏やかなご参拝を。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed the type, color, and quantity. May you have a peaceful shrine visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。お受取りのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. Would you like to discuss receiving your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家にはいたのですが、呼出し音に気づきませんでした。不在と書かれているので少し戸惑っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 在宅でも呼出しに気づかず不在票が入ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was at home, but I didn't notice the doorbell. I'm a little confused because it says I was absent.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you were home but missed the doorbell and received a missed-delivery notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達の状況は担当へ確認します。受取れなかったことと、今後の受取りを分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the delivery circumstances with the person responsible. We'll discuss the failed delivery and future receipt separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今後は家族とも予定を合わせたいです。私が外出する時間に、家族がいるかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の未確認の在宅予定を受取り相談として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: For the next delivery, I'd like to coordinate with my family too. I haven't yet asked whether someone will be home when I go out.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your family's availability at home is still unconfirmed as part of discussing receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 再配達の希望を出す前に、受け取る予定を相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please discuss your arrangements for receiving it before requesting redelivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族へ連絡します。私の都合だけで受取時刻を選んで、家族に任せるのは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再配達希望を出す前に家族へ予定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll contact my family. I'll avoid choosing a delivery time just for my own convenience and leaving it to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check your family's schedule before requesting redelivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取りの方法は、お荷物の案内に沿って担当からご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will explain the receiving methods in accordance with the information for your parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物によって条件も確認する必要があるんですね。家族が必ず受け取れるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物の受取り条件を家族の在宅と別に確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I also need to check the conditions for this particular parcel. I won't assume my family can definitely receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the parcel's receiving conditions separately from whether your family will be home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予定が決まってから、ご利用できる方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once your plans are settled, please ask about the methods available to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族の予定を聞いてから申し込みます。呼出しに気づかなかった点も、問い合わせでは事実として説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定確認後の申込みと在宅時の事実説明を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll make the request after asking my family's schedule. When I inquire, I'll also explain as a fact that I didn't notice the doorbell.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to apply after checking schedules and explain what happened while you were home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 配達状況と次の受取りを分けて確認してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUEFUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the delivery circumstances and the next receipt separately. Thank you for discussing this with us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この便は周遊です。ご利用の目的を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a sightseeing cruise. May I check the purpose of your trip?

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 対岸で友人に迎えてもらう予定です。向こうの乗り場で降りられると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 対岸での迎えを前提に降船可能と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend is supposed to pick me up on the opposite shore. I came because I thought I could get off at the landing over there.
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought you could disembark because someone would meet you on the opposite shore. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この便は出発した乗り場へ戻ります。対岸への移動には使えません。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-03.translation: This service returns to the landing it leaves from. It cannot be used to travel to the opposite shore.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 周遊と移動を同じように考えていました。まだ券を買っていないので、先に予定を見直します。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 周遊と移動を区別し券購入前に予定を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was treating a sightseeing cruise and transport as the same thing. I haven't bought a ticket yet, so I'll reconsider my plans first.
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish sightseeing cruises from transport and review your plans before buying a ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 景色をご覧になるために乗るか、移動の方法を調べ直すかをご検討ください。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consider whether to board to enjoy the scenery or look into transportation again.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は友人と会うことが目的です。景色を見る乗船はせず、対岸へ行く別の方法を調べます。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 観光乗船をせず友人に会う移動方法を探すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-06.translation: My purpose today is to meet my friend. I won't take a sightseeing cruise; I'll look for another way to reach the opposite shore.
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to take a sightseeing cruise and to find transportation to meet your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 観光案内の担当へ相談できます。迎えの場所は、お相手と確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can consult the tourist information staff. Have you confirmed the pickup location with your friend?

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 湖の向こう側という言い方だけでした。乗り場とは限らないので、場所の名前も聞き直します。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迎え先の名称が未確認で相手に聞き直すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-08.translation: They only said the other side of the lake. It may not be a landing, so I'll ask again for the place's name too.
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the pickup location's name is unconfirmed and you will ask the other person again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 具体的な場所が分かってから、そこまでの移動を相談してください。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know the specific location, please ask about getting there.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人へ、船で着く予定は変更すると連絡します。場所の名前が分かってから案内担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 船到着の予定変更を連絡し場所確定後に移動を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend that my plan to arrive by boat has changed. After I know the place's name, I'll ask the information staff.
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Communicate the change to your boat-arrival plan and seek transportation advice after confirming the location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 目的と到着先を確認してからお進めください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please confirm your purpose and destination before proceeding. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: その列へ並ぶ前に、ご利用の便を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: Before joining that queue, would you like to check your service?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: 行先が同じなのでここだと思いました。でも、券に書かれた会社名と看板が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintJa: 行先と会社名の不一致に気づいたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: I thought this was the right place because the destination is the same. But the company name on my ticket differs from the sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed the destination matches but the company name does not. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: 予約の便名と発車時刻をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: Please show me your booked service name and departure time.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: この便です。行先だけで判断せず、会社名と時刻も合わせて見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintJa: 券の便名と時刻を示して複数情報を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: This is my service. I'll compare the company name and time too, instead of judging by the destination alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintTranslation: Show the ticket's service name and time and compare several pieces of information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: お持ちの券は、あちらの看板の会社です。待つ場所を指してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: Your ticket is for the company on that sign over there. I'll point out where you should wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: 分かりました。今の列から静かに抜けて、荷物も全部持って移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintJa: 誤った列を離れ荷物とともに正しい場所へ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: Understood. I'll quietly leave this queue and take all my luggage with me to the right place.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintTranslation: Leave the wrong queue and move to the correct location with your luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: 移った先でも、乗る車両の便名を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: Even after moving there, please check the service name on the vehicle you board.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: 看板は合っています。バスが来たら、荷物を預ける前に便名を乗務員へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintJa: 手荷物を預ける前に車両の便名を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: The sign matches. When the bus arrives, I'll confirm the service name with the crew before handing over my luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the vehicle's service name before handing over your luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: 席の番号は乗車後に確認できます。まず予約便への乗車を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: You can check your seat number after boarding. First, let's confirm you are boarding your reserved service.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: 便を確認してから乗り、その後で席を探します。こちらの会社の列には戻りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintJa: 便の確認と座席探しの順序を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: I'll board after confirming the service, then look for my seat. I won't return to this company's queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.hintTranslation: Clarify the order of confirming the service and finding your seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.sourceJa: 会社と便を照合できましたね。それでは、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-02-001-SH.translation: We've matched the company and service. Have a pleasant trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: この部屋の清掃で、判断に迷う物はあったか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: Was there anything in this room you weren't sure how to handle while cleaning?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: ごみ箱の横に封書があります。箱の中ではないので、捨ててよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintJa: ごみ箱外の封書を廃棄してよいか不明と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: There's a sealed letter beside the wastebasket. Since it isn't inside the bin, I don't know whether I may throw it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintTranslation: Report that you are unsure whether a sealed letter outside the wastebasket may be discarded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: 開けずに置いた場所を知らせてくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: Tell me where it is without opening it.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: 机の下の右側です。宛名の内容を読まず、封が閉じていることだけ確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintJa: 封を開かず発見位置と観察範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: It's on the right under the desk. I haven't read the addressee details; I only checked that the envelope is sealed.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintTranslation: Explain where you found it and what you observed without opening the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: ごみと分けて、責任者に扱いを確認する。ほかの清掃員にも触らないよう伝えよう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: We'll keep it separate from the rubbish and ask the person responsible how to handle it. Let's also tell the other cleaners not to touch it.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: まだその周辺は片づけません。交代する人へ、確認待ちの封書があると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintJa: 周辺を片づけず交代者へ確認待ちを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: I won't tidy that area yet. I'll tell the person taking over that there is a sealed letter awaiting confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintTranslation: Leave the surrounding area untouched and tell the next worker it is awaiting confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: 場所の記録は、個人情報を広めない形で残してくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: Record its location in a way that doesn't spread personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: 部屋番号と位置を作業記録へ書きます。封書の写真を私物の携帯で撮るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintJa: 個人情報を撮影せず作業記録に場所を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: I'll write the room number and location in the work record. I won't photograph the letter with my personal phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintTranslation: Record the location in the work record without photographing personal information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: 扱いが決まるまでは、回収済みと記録しないでくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: Until its handling has been decided, don't record it as collected.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: 未処理で確認待ちと書きます。返答後、指示された扱いと担当者を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintJa: 未処理状態と今後の指示記録を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: I'll write that it is unprocessed and awaiting confirmation. After the response, I'll record the instructed handling and the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.hintTranslation: Distinguish its unprocessed status from the instructions you will record later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.sourceJa: 封書をそのまま残し、確認待ちの報告を受けた。ありがとう。では、次の引継ぎで。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-03-001-SH.translation: I've received your report that the letter remains untouched and is awaiting confirmation. Thank you. See you at the next handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: お弁当はお二人で分けられるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: Are the two of you planning to share the boxed meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: そうでしたが、同行者は先に別の店で食べたそうです。私一人で食べる量に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintJa: 同行者の予定変更により一人用へ選び直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: We were, but apparently my companion has already eaten at another shop. I'd like to change to an amount for just me.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintTranslation: Explain that you will choose a meal for one because your companion's plans changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: ご注文はまだ確定していませんので、選び直していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: Your order hasn't been finalized yet, so you can choose again.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: 大きい方を頼む前でよかったです。持ち帰ってすぐ食べるので、小さい方を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintJa: 注文確定前に少量の弁当を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: I'm glad I hadn't ordered the large one yet. I'll eat it as soon as I take it away, so I'd like to see the small one.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintTranslation: Ask to see a smaller boxed meal before confirming your order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: 小さい方はこちらです。主菜の種類は大きい方と異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: Here's the small one. Its main dish is different from the large one's.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: 量だけでなく料理も違うんですね。こちらの魚の弁当なら、一人で食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintJa: 量と主菜の違いを理解して魚の弁当を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: So the dishes differ as well as the amount. I'd like to eat this fish meal on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintTranslation: Understand the differences in quantity and main dish and choose the fish meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: 小さい魚のお弁当を一つでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: Would you like one small fish boxed meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: 一つお願いします。取り分け用の箸を二つ付ける必要もなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintJa: 一つの注文と一膳の箸を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: One, please. I no longer need two sets of chopsticks for sharing either.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintTranslation: Specify one meal and one pair of chopsticks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: お箸は一膳でご用意します。ほかのお品は追加されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: I'll provide one pair of chopsticks. Would you like to add anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: 追加はしません。この一つで会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintJa: 追加なしで会計を頼み最終注文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: I won't add anything. Please let me pay for just this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.hintTranslation: Finalize your order by asking to pay without adding anything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.sourceJa: 小さい魚のお弁当とお箸一膳で承りました。それでは、よいお昼を。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-04-001-SH.translation: One small fish boxed meal and one pair of chopsticks. Enjoy your lunch.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: その袋の中の色を確認されたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: Would you like to check the color inside that bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: はい。外から見えないので、買う前に一つ開けたくなりました。店で確認する方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintJa: 開封せず購入前に中の色を知る方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: Yes. I can't see it from outside, so I felt like opening one before buying it. Is there a way to check in the shop?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintTranslation: Ask how to learn the color inside before buying without opening it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: 販売用の袋は開けずお待ちください。見本の有無を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: Please wait without opening the bags for sale. I'll check whether there is a sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: まだ封は切っていません。商品は棚から一つだけ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintJa: 未開封で持参した数量を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: I haven't broken the seal yet. I've brought just one item from the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintTranslation: State that it is unopened and how many items you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: この品は色を選べない組合せで、見本もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: This item comes in an assortment whose color you cannot choose, and there is no sample either.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: 必ず青色が必要なので、運任せで買うのはやめます。色を指定できる別の品を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintJa: 色が選べない品を見送り指定できる別品を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: I definitely need blue, so I won't buy it and leave it to chance. I'd like to see another item whose color I can specify.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintTranslation: Pass on the item whose color you cannot choose and ask for another with a selectable color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: こちらは外から青色が分かりますが、形が少し違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: You can see that this one is blue from outside, but its shape is slightly different.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: 丸い形でも使えます。色の確認ができるこちらを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintJa: 形の差を受け入れて確認可能な色の商品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: I can use a round shape too. I'll choose this one whose color I can check.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintTranslation: Accept the difference in shape and choose an item whose color you can verify. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: 最初にお持ちの品は、こちらで棚へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: I'll put the first item you brought back on the shelf for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: 最初の袋は開けないままお渡しします。買うのは青色が見える方だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintJa: 元の未開封品を戻し購入品を明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: I'll give you the first bag still unopened. I'm buying only the one whose blue color is visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.hintTranslation: Return the original unopened item and clarify which item you will buy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.sourceJa: 未開封の品をお戻しいただきありがとうございます。それでは、レジでお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-05-001-SH.translation: Thank you for returning the unopened item. I'll see you at the checkout.
